Name: CHAOS mod for Stardew Valley
Author: DevWithMaj
Description:
Stardew Valley but CHAOS is rampant. Every 30 seconds something happens, whether monsters spawn, you drop your held item, or you are teleported randomly away. Gameplay video on youtube: https://youtu.be/Arr7pV1YdrI

Code is open source: https://github.com/DevWithMaj/Stardew-CHAOS
Feel free to contribute :)

Manifest.Name: Stardew_CHAOS_Mod
Manifest.Description: Random things happen every 60 seconds, good or bad. Similar to GTA5 chaos mod
